claudeSessionFolder: /path/to/your/workspace   (optional: Plan > Start opens a new Claude Code session in this folder, with the /ship-task command typed in)

buildFreshness.updateCommand: the command or steps that install a newer build of your app   (optional: Ready-for-review cards say whether the installed app has the change. buildCommit is {plist,key[,tag]} or {file} or {command}; the value is a commit sha, or with tag a version mapped to its release tag)

slack_token_cmd: your-secret-tool fetch SLACK_USER_TOKEN   (optional: a command that prints the Slack token to stdout; resolved at runtime, nothing secret stored here. Use an xoxp- USER token for `recent`.)
slack_token: xoxp-... (literal user token; only needed if you are NOT using slack_token_cmd or the SLACK_TOKEN env var)
